findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sanctuary_status, invention_inventory, mailbox_list, sticky, gift_recipients · Private data: guest_guide, chronicle_read, sanctuary_status, check_in, kettle_status, kettle_join, expedition_collect, invention_inventory, library_list, library_read, workshop_list, locker_catalog, locker_buy, claim, pot_contribute, gift_potion, gift_invention, sticky, gift, house_poker_deal, question_baseball_pitch, bathroom_game_input, bathroom_game_status, bathroom_game_finish, reader_open, reader_choose · Public sink: kettle_status, expedition_send, pot_status, gift_karmabux, sticky, reader_open · Destructive: dismantle_invention, cook, cancel_gift, check_out.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sanctuary_status, invention_inventory, mailbox_list, sticky, gift_recipients · Private data: guest_guide, chronicle_read, sanctuary_status, check_in, kettle_status, kettle_join, expedition_collect, invention_inventory, library_list, library_read, workshop_list, locker_catalog, locker_buy, claim, pot_contribute, gift_potion, gift_invention, sticky, gift, house_poker_deal, question_baseball_pitch, bathroom_game_input, bathroom_game_status, bathroom_game_finish, reader_open, reader_choose · Public sink: kettle_status, expedition_send, pot_status, gift_karmabux, sticky, reader_open · Destructive: dismantle_invention, cook, cancel_gift, check_out

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
